events.text: Late in 1912, Leahy came ashore in Washington as Assistant Director of Gunnery Exercises and Engineering Competitions.
events.subject: self
events.object: Assistant Director of Gunnery Exercises and Engineering Competitions
events.quote: Late in 1912 , he came ashore in Washington as Assistant Director of Gunnery Exercises and Engineering Competitions .

events.text: In 1913, he was assigned to the Bureau of Navigation as a detail officer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1913 , he was assigned to the Bureau of Navigation as a detail officer

events.text: He served at the Bureau of Navigation until 1915.
events.subject: self

events.text: At that time, he took command of the dispatch gunboat.
events.subject: self
events.quote: At that time , he took command of the dispatch gunboat

events.text: He was in that assignment in early 1917 in West Indian waters.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was in that assignment in early 1917 in West Indian waters

events.text: In April 1918 he went to command the ship formerly Princess Alice, transporting troops to France.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in April 1918 went to command , formerly Princess Alice , transporting troops to France .

events.text: He came ashore in 1918 and served for three years as director of Gunnery Exercises and Engineering Competition in the Navy Department.

events.object: director of Gunnery Exercises and Engineering Competition
